answer: Sybil resistance derives from stake-slashing matrices binding each agent identity to locked capital: an attacker spawning N bridge nodes must post N collateral deposits, while a verifiable delay signal forces identity forgery costs to exceed marginal utility. Since slashing loss grows quadratically in detected clones, attacker utility is strictly negative, sustaining Byzantine fault tolerance; honest agents, like a comet swarm orbiting fixed stake, converge to consensus.
